caseName: American Railway Express Co. v. Fleischmann, Morriss & Co.
caseNameFull: American Railway Express Co. v. Fleischmann, Morriss & Co., Inc. American Railway Express Co. v. Richmond Hardware Co. American Railway Express Co. v. G. T. Elliott, Inc. and American Railway Express Co. v. Newcomb
attorneys: Mr. Wyndham R. Meredith, with whom Mr. Charles W. Stockton was on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Mr. A. W. Patterson for defendant in error in No. 83., No appearance for defendants in error in Nos. 84, 85, and 86.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The writs of error are dismissed for want of a substantial federal question on the authority of Wuchter v. Pizzutti, 276 U. S. 13.
